LightningComponentBundle.description: Generic bar chart for grouped record data.

property.name: filter
property.label: Filter override
property.description: Optional filter passed to the chart controller.

property.name: orientation
property.label: Bar orientation
property.description: Orientation of the bars: vertical or horizontal.

property.name: legendTitle
property.label: Legend title
property.description: Optional title displayed above the legend.

property.name: legendPosition
property.label: Legend position
property.description: Position of the legend: bottom, right, or top.

property.name: legendMaxTextWidth
property.label: Legend text width
property.description: Maximum width of each legend label in pixels.

property.name: showValuesButton
property.label: Show values button
property.description: Display the button that toggles values on the chart.

property.name: showExpandButton
property.label: Show expand button
property.description: Display the button that opens the chart in a modal.
